canon_pins.refusal_worlddef: A system that refuses to close can never rest.
canon_pins.the_no_gate_line: A thing that refuses completion cannot be written down.
canon_pins.law_text: If it would end, un-end it.
canon_pins.steel_on_hub_gate: The Crucible gate stone is on the Hub ring at (24.04, -24.04). That point is 34 m from the Court origin and sits inside the 42 m disk, so steel on the gate stone is a flower. Country floors in this slice are a different book. Steel on those floors stays live.
canon_pins.fight_style_people: Pem's archetype is scholar, so PickFight returns Wing Chun. Vaud's archetype engineer_administrator, Calla's priest, and Taln's elder_survivor match none of the archetype tests, so they take the Crucible default Sword. Empty hands on the four uniques. The mystic focus wpn_focus_crucible_unend stays on npc_role_crucible_mystic. Ritual blade, repair tool, scavenged blade, dagger, shortsword, spear, and every other faction weapon archetype stay on the sheets that already name them. This facet binds none of those meshes.
canon_pins.flower_law: Hub only. Canon.HubLawRadius is 42 m and does not govern a Crucible country disc. The nearest capital to a Crucible-local origin is the Drift Cultists at 33.00 m. That nearness is not the Court disk. Do not flower a country anchor.

unresolved_on_purpose: Orla's player-conditional drift corpus stays her secret and crucible_lore_orla_observation.hidden_truth. She has not told the other Witnesses. Her midday block is central_crucible, the same hours as Pem. This facet stands Pem only and does not give her a mouth.

The charter amendment is public lore: Sael has proposed intervention when a drift event endangers a player. Orla calls that a violation. Pem is wavering. The vote is not taken. Sael's midday block is also central_crucible, from hour 10. She is not stood. Her practice yard has no anchor.

The cross-world pact is not public. Lore says three people know and known_by is an empty list. The sheets name Voss Dren, Calla Bren of the sovereign-ruins, and the child Kit Voss. This facet does not enumerate them on a board. q_crucible_hear_pact and lattice_voss_02_pact already own the hearing. lattice_voss_03_calla already owns the carry into the Ruins. Kit is not stood.

high_priestess_calla_drift is not Calla Bren. The priestess's suspicion that stabilizations are themselves drift events, and that the engineers would then be unwitting prophets, stays her secret. She has not told her followers. The faction tension repeats the notice and the indecision. This slice does not post either.

Vaud's three patches that birthed the current refugee population stay his secret. He reported them to the federation and has not told the refugees. Taln has known since her sixth year, from a patch-revert log Mez dropped, and has not confronted him. Neither fact is a quest. Mez is not stood. His bunkhouse has no anchor.

Rina rediscovered two of three alloys. The master refused the recipe. The third line stays blank. Her secret, that the alloys harmonise with the Hub focus-lattice and that Lyra Brassgate has noticed, stays her secret. lattice_calvex_forge has no x,z. She is not stood. S17's rib notch already owns the unclosed quartz on the 7.66 m open. This facet does not retell that fight and does not name the alloys.

Emer's maps are the public sentence: at eighteen she crossed the verge alone for three days and returned with maps the Crucible would not publicly recognize. The matching print, Kiren Owl, and the breach stay the Emer chain and q_crucible_print_tracks. lattice_verge_north has no anchor. She is not stood. No species is invented.

Ono's forty-year silence and the sealed letter stay the Ono chain and q_crucible_bog_letter. lattice_sage_hut and lattice_circle have no country anchor. She is not stood. The letter is not summarized.

Andra's generation seed stays her secret. The public split is the faction tension: she trusts the Witnesses and many do not. Her backstory, that she was generated as a patrol guard for a quest that ended within an hour and did not despawn, is public and is the slate's sentence. the_unwriting_yard has no anchor. She is not stood. No vote is held.

Oran's knowledge that the reader is the player is his backstory, and the journal addressed to the player is his secret. He has not decided whether to give it. recursion_balcony has no anchor. He is not stood. The observatory stays empty. This facet does not hand the journal over.
Yorin Cheval has been in the Crucible six weeks, has refused the Witnesses, and has not stopped taking notes. central_crucible_dining is not the district anchor. Yorin is not stood.

The Drift Walker has paced the perimeter for four years, is not a Courier, and does not answer a handshake. Sael believes it delivers to whoever can authenticate. Orla believes it malfunctions. crucible_perimeter has no anchor. The walker is not stood. S17 already loans one mystic walker onto the moth open during enc_vein_short. This facet does not add a second.

The seven doors have no x,z. The seventh stays unclassified. Six new drift types have emerged and one has been promoted. No eighth door is hung. Walking a door into a procgen region is the monument's own behavior and is not staged here.

The Iron Wardens' travel advisory is public: a drift event killed a Concordian envoy, the quarantine motion failed, the advisory has stood for two years, and drift-marks do not cash to Concord Coin without a Warden signature. This facet reads that sentence on the witness anchor and does not travel to Concordia. No Warden is stood.

The first breakthrough, drift in one city and undelivered Frontier parcels six weeks later, is a published finding. The Couriers' six-week tolerance stays that guild's rule. This facet does not carry a parcel and does not open the Frontier.
The first lattice-born quest, Whose macros are these?, resolved when a misconfigured load-test runner was retired. It is not restaged.

calvex_forge, lattice_cohort, kell_circle, and verge_scouts are lore cohort ids. They are not country rows. They are not a seventh, eighth, ninth, or tenth polity. open_lattice and court_witness are volume delta strings and are not in factions.json. This slice writes no delta under any of those ids.

Levels on the four stood sheets stay 8, 11, 9, and 5. This facet assigns no hit points from those numbers.
Country climate logs 15 degrees, humidity 50, wind low. WorldDef weather is drift. This slice does not edit the climate rows.

The Unclosed Foundry blend in the art direction is Crucible quartz through Crime brass. Steampunk is not its own world. This facet does not build that blend on the Iron Coast and does not place the foundry kit to illustrate it.

cultures.name: The bench
cultures.public_fact: The Witnesses say they watch the lattice write itself. The charter says observe, document, do not intervene. Sael has formally proposed an amendment that would permit intervention when a drift event endangers a player. Orla considers the amendment a violation of the charter's purpose. Pem is wavering, and his midday activity is a council in which he usually does not take a position. Reputation on the sheet is 60. The currency is a drift mark, and this slice pays none. The seven doors were built by the first three Witnesses. The seventh is unclassified. Six new types have emerged since, and one has been promoted. Concordia's quarantine motion failed. The unofficial travel advisory has stood for two years. Drift-marks do not cash to Concord Coin without a Warden signature.
cultures.identity: A bench identity is a midday council on an anchor 10 m inside the Witnesses capital, with one person stood and two others present on the sheet and absent on the floor. The doors have no coordinate, so the count is filed here. The advisory is read here and is not a road to Concordia.
cultures.stops_before: Orla's corpus, a vote, an eighth door, a cashed mark, a Warden body, and any edit to reputation 60.

cultures.name: The desk
cultures.public_fact: The Lattice Engineers say stabilize, document, propagate the fix. Vaud was the federation's lead patch developer for three years. He believes the lattice can be taught to drift less, one patch at a time. The cultists hate him. The Witnesses are wary. The refugees mostly leave him alone. He refuses to discuss theology. Reputation is 58. The currency is a patch credit, and this slice pays none. Rina Calvex's master discovered three alloys that harmonize with the focus-lattice and refused to teach the recipe. Rina rediscovered two. The public foundry is that sentence on this desk, because lattice_calvex_forge has no pin. Palette of the kit is basalt, quartz, obsidian glass, and dark oak. Quartz ribs do not close.
cultures.identity: A foundry identity is a desk 10 m inside the engineer capital, 58.75 m from the only seam a 4 m bay can occupy, and a third alloy line that stays blank. The workshop anchor sits on the side of the capital away from the 20.11 m overlap with the cult. The bay is a recommendation S17 already wrote. This culture does not pour it.
cultures.stops_before: The third recipe, the Hub harmony, Vaud's three patches, a seated arch_ix_crucible_foundry, a theology argument, and any edit to reputation 58.

cultures.name: The six glyphs
cultures.public_fact: The Drift Cultists say every contradiction is a door. Their goal is to worship the contradictions the lattice surfaces and to resist stabilization of what should be revered. Calla saw her first drift event at sixteen, converted within the hour, and is thirty-eight. She has shaped the theology around contradictions as revelation. Her public speech is a liturgical cadence. Reputation is 45. The currency is a drift token, and this slice pays none. The temple anchor is 7.44 m from the meta observatory anchor. Both circles nest. The pilgrimage path, where she walks at midday, has no pin.
cultures.identity: A glyph identity is a morning reception and an afternoon sermon on a pin 10 m inside the cult capital. Six glyphs are interpreted. A verdict about the engineers is not in the sermon this facet will hear. She is not the Calla of the bog.
cultures.stops_before: The prophet reading, a seventh glyph, a merge with Calla Bren, a walk of the unpinned pilgrimage, and any edit to reputation 45.

cultures.name: The twelve
cultures.public_fact: The Drift Refugees say their home was a contradiction the lattice could not hold. The goal is to survive, to find others from collapsed zones, and to build a settlement that will not itself become a drift target. Taln was a builder. The settlement collapsed eight years ago. She walked out with her surviving family and arrived with twelve others. She uses we to mean those twelve. A second wave has arrived and reports the same patterns. The first-wave elders are wary. Reputation is 52. The currency is a haven chit, and this slice pays none. The camp anchor is outside the engineer circle.
cultures.identity: A camp identity is intake in the morning and maintenance in the afternoon on a pin 10 m inside the refugee capital. Origin is documented as a field. This facet supplies no zone name, because the lore supplies none. The field kitchen, where the meals are, has no anchor, so the meals are not staged.
cultures.stops_before: A named cause, a confrontation with Vaud, a zone name, a kitchen scene, and any edit to reputation 52.

cultures.name: The assembly and the balcony
cultures.where: procgen_assembly_hall and the empty meta observatory
cultures.public_fact: The Procgen Collective says we were generated, so were you. Andra was generated three years ago as a patrol guard for a quest that ended within an hour. She did not despawn. She speaks for the Collective when an authored faction asks, and she does not speak when one does not ask. The faction tension is that she trusts the Witnesses and many do not. Reputation is 50. The Meta-Witnesses say they are aware they are inside a writeable simulation, and so are you. Their goal is a bridge that does not force one ontology. Reputation is 65. Neither currency is paid.
cultures.identity: An assembly identity is a slate on a pin 10 m inside the procgen capital, and an observatory 10 m inside the meta capital with nobody on it. The ground floor stays the culture. A vote would be a completion. A handed-over journal would be a completion. Neither happens.
cultures.stops_before: Andra's seed, Oran's journal, a vote, a despawn, a seventh ontology, and any edit to reputation 50 or 65.

side_quests.title: Witness Anchor — The Bench Does Not Vote

objectives.text: At (-54.76, -0.51), ask where the charter stands. He will say: observe, document, do not intervene. He will say Sael has proposed intervention when a drift event endangers a player, and that Orla considers the amendment a violation. He will say he has not voted. He will not fetch Orla or Sael onto the anchor.

File the monument from the same bench. Seven doors. The seventh is unclassified. Six new drift types have emerged. One has been promoted. Do not hang an eighth door. The doors have no coordinate, so you do not walk one.

Read the public advisory. A drift event killed a Concordian envoy. The quarantine motion failed at the Council of Twelve. The advisory has stood for two years. Drift-marks do not become Concord Coin without a Warden signature. Do not cash a mark. Do not leave for Concordia. Do not stand a Warden.
Bring back the three open lines: amendment unvoted, doors still seven, mark uncashed. He does not pay a drift mark. He does not take a position because you returned.

fail: Travel to Concordia for the signature

world_hooks.board_line: Charter open. Seven doors. The mark was not cashed.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Pem kept the bench and kept his vote in his pocket.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: Witness anchor. No eighth door is built.

side_quests.title: Six Gates — No Pact on the Board

objectives.text: Ask whether the continent has declared a cross-world pact. He will say the public record has no declaration. He will not say who met, where, or how many know. He will not send you to a drill yard or a lattice circle.

Read the board at each capital, and write that none of them carries a pact line. The Witnesses gate is (-62.76, 5.49). The Drift Cultists gate is (28.29, -17.0). The Lattice Engineers gate is (48.72, -36.71). The Drift Refugees gate is (44.99, 9.56). The Procgen Collective gate is (-24.55, -26.33). The Meta-Witnesses gate is (35.64, -18.16). Do not add a line to any board. Do not treat a motto as a pact.

Stop. Hearing the pact, refusing a completion clause, and carrying a confirmation are q_crucible_hear_pact and the Voss chain. Do not open them from this errand. Do not ask the priestess at the temple. She is a different Calla.
Return the six blanks to the bench. He does not name a signatory. He does not pay a mark.

fail: Name Voss, Calla Bren, or Kit
Carry a confirmation into the Ruins
Ask the high priestess about a pact

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: The public record stayed unsigned. The hearing stayed in its own quest.

side_quests.title: Witness Anchor — Maps, Unrecognized

objectives.text: Ask what the Witnesses will say in public about Emer Voss. He will say she crossed the verge alone at eighteen, was gone three days, returned with maps the Crucible would not publicly recognize, and has been mapping since. He will not show you a print.
File two sentences and stop: the maps exist, and public recognition does not. Do not invent a species. Do not draw a sketch. Do not walk lattice_verge_north. That string has no anchor.
Walk the 10 m to the Witnesses capital at (-62.76, 5.49). Leave the non-recognition on that gate's board. Do not continue to the 3.72 m open. The moths and q_s17_vein_short already own that floor.
Bring the filing back. Emer is not stood beside him. Kiren is not introduced. The breach is the next canon step of a different quest, and it is not this turn-in.

fail: Invent a species for the print
Correct a moth wing on the way to the gate

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Pem posted the crossing and posted no print.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: Witness gate. No verge mesh is built.

side_quests.title: Engineer Desk — Two, and a Blank

objectives.text: At (56.72, -42.71), ask what the foundry will say in public. He will say a master discovered three alloys that harmonize with the focus-lattice and refused to teach the recipe, and that Rina Calvex rediscovered two. He will not name them. He will not discuss theology.
On the card at the desk, count two rediscoveries. Leave the third line blank. Do not write a recipe. Do not write that the alloys harmonize with the Hub lattice. That sentence is not his to give you.

Walk the 10 m to the engineer capital at (48.72, -36.71). The forge string lattice_calvex_forge has no coordinate, so you do not visit Rina. Do not stand her. Do not place unend_hall, shard_yard, or leaning_stack to host the card.
Bring the card back with the third line still blank. He does not pay a patch credit. The rib on the 7.66 m open stays q_s17_rib_notch.

world_hooks.board_line: Two alloys rediscovered. The third line is blank.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Vaud kept the card and kept the recipe untaught.

side_quests.title: Seam — The Bay Stays a Measure

objectives.text: Ask where a 4 m foundry module could sit. He will give you three measures and no hammer. The module footprint is 4 m. Door clear is 1.2 by 2.2 m. A corridor is at least 2.4 m. He will not place arch_ix_crucible_foundry.
Stand at (-43.66, -10.42). Write 3.72 m. A 4 m bay does not fit. If the moths are up, leave them. Do not correct a wing. Do not become the finisher of enc_vein_short.
Stand at (10.85, -31.34), 47.26 m from the desk. Write 25.50 m. The open is wide enough and it is already the drift floor, cap 2. Do not seat a bay here. If enc_two_masses is up, do not finish it.

Stand at (1.87, -21.66), 58.75 m from the desk. Write 7.66 m, with 1.83 m of air on each side of a 4 m bay. This is the only country gap the module can occupy.
